as_told.title: Jason Sands sees blue alien being at Nellis range

plain: A man named Jason Sands says that in August 1994, at the Nellis testing range, a military area in Nevada, he came face to face with someone in a military outfit who, by his account, did not look human. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells the story, which Sands gave as part of Fox's film project The Program. Fox mentions it several times in one conversation, at one point just thanking Sands "for including that encounter in Nellis," and at another describing "a guy dressed in you know military outfit that clearly according to him did not appear to be human." Michels also repeats it in a later episode, from Sands and Fox, though his version calls the being a blue alien and gives no date. If true, it would mean a non-human being was working inside a US military site.
